meta.title: Stellaria
meta.extra: Easy chart v2: quarter-note pulse on the original onsets (the accented off-beat when stronger), one 8th pair per bar (every 2 bars at Lv3) at a fixed place, a downbeat chord per bar, holds only on real sustains; lanes follow the original contour while keeping the hands alternating, no jacks inside a beat, no spirals.

autoCoef.description: Final speedupCoef = baseSpeedupCoef * autoSpeedupCoefMultiplier. Load restores editable coef 0/1 from baseSpeedupCoef.
